settings.title: The Discovery
settings.text: After many long days going from the gym to the office to the trails, we discovered that the usual performance socks we depended on weren't cutting it anymore. We decided to take matters into our own hands and discovered the magic of alpaca fibers.

settings.title: The Research
settings.text: We spent two years researching and testing the best places to source alpaca fibers, the best type of alpaca fibers to use, and the best way to turn magical alpaca fibers into trustworthy performance socks.

settings.title: The Result
settings.text: Today, we proudly supply trustworthy performance socks using our unique alpaca fiber blend to adventurers around the country. Our socks keep feet everywhere dry and comfortable.

settings.title: TEMPERATURE REGULATING
settings.text: Alpaca fibers have a semi-hollow core that act like natural insulation allowing the fibers to trap warm air when it’s cold, and release heat when warm.

settings.title: BREATHABLE & LIGHT
settings.text: Alpaca fiber is naturally lightweight and breathable allowing it to adapt to any temperature while keeping you comfortable even in the harshest conditions.

settings.title: SOFT ALPACA FIBER
settings.text: Alpaca fibers are naturally smooth, and have a lower scale structure—meaning no coarse, or itchy feeling you get with wool.

settings.title: MOISTURE WICKING
settings.text: Alpaca fibers naturally repel moisture thanks to their low absorption rate, about 8% versus wool’s 30%, and cotton’s 60%.

settings.title: ODOR RESISTANT
settings.text: Unlike synthetic socks that trap moisture and odor over time, alpaca fibers make bacterial growth difficult, reducing the root cause of foot odor.

settings.hero_text: After two years of real-world testing, alpaca stood above everything else for comfort and performance.
